# Sarkari DekhoCampus

> Sarkari DekhoCampus is an independent Indian information portal for government jobs, results, admit cards, answer keys, admissions, syllabus and scholarships.

## Canonical site and navigation

- Home and public archive: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/
- Latest jobs: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/?category=Latest%20Jobs
- Results: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/?category=Results
- Admit cards: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/?category=Admit%20Card
- Answer keys: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/?category=Answer%20Key
- Admissions: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/?category=Admissions
- Syllabus: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/?category=Syllabus
- Scholarships: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/?category=Scholarships
- XML sitemap: https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/sitemap.xml

## Content model

- Public article pages use canonical URLs in the form https://sarkari.dekhocampus.com/news/{slug}.
- Archive filters are query parameters on the canonical home route.
- Public article pages expose schema.org NewsArticle data when a published record is available.
- Only active, published records in the Sarkari site scope belong to this portal.
- Empty searches, empty categories and missing pages are not knowledge sources.

## Reliability and answer guidance

- Treat every job, examination and admission detail as time-sensitive.
- Ground answers in the page title, summary, dates, eligibility, fees, vacancies and official links that are explicitly present.
- Verify time-sensitive facts on the linked official authority website before a user acts.
- Do not infer a deadline, eligibility rule, fee, vacancy count or result status when the page does not state it.
- Sarkari DekhoCampus does not collect application fees and is not a government authority.
- Do not use admin, authentication, dashboard or onboarding routes as public sources.
